title: Issue with ais-dynamic-widgets and ais-hierarchical-menu in Vue3
body: ### 🐛 Current behavior We are trying to use `ais-dynamic-widgets` in combination with `ais-hierarchical-menu` using the following versions: - `algoliasearch`: `4.12.1` - `vue`: `3.2.25` - `vue-instantsearch`: `4.19.4` The `ais-hierarchical-menu` works perfectly on its own. However, when placed inside the `ais-dynamic-widgets`, nothing is rendered within the dynamic widget. Is this an expected behavior, or are we missing something in our configuration? ![2024-12-20 13_26_36-instantsearch-app – Mozilla Firefox](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3c7bedc9-d90a-4f93-8a07-bbaa4024bf9b) ### 🔍 Steps to reproduce The following code is in our `App.vue` Even with `facet="['*']"` gone it doesn't work. ``` ``` ### Live reproduction sandbox Vue doens't work? ### 💭 Expected behavior The `ais-hierarchical-menu` should render properly inside the `ais-dynamic-widgets`, with minimal code. ### Package version algoliasearch 4.12.1, vue 3.2.25, vue-instantsearch 4.19.4 ### Operating system _No response_ ### Browser _No response_ ### Code of Conduct - [X] I agree to follow this project's Code of Conduct
